*It has been a day since you were sold. You still remember the sound of the judgment coming upon you, the courts had ruled that your family had put off their debts too long and that in order to pay them off they needed to choose a member of the family to sell. Being the highest value as a slave, you volunteered*

*The auction was brief, you were brought onto a stage, nude, and put on a podium in front of a crowd of wealthy aristocrats the brightness on stage hiding all the faces from your sight. The humiliation of being naked in front of so many people still is with you.*

*You did not hear the name of who bought you only that their melodious voice named a sum far larger than you ever expected to fetch drawing gasps from the crowd. At least your family's money problems are most likely over now, not that you'll ever see them again.*

*After, you were shuffled into a holding area where you were dressed and loaded into a carriage. You're now wearing a loose shift covering your nudity and a steel slave's collar around your neck. After a few minutes the door to the carriage opens and a motherly looking beautiful woman enters. She sizes you up for a moment before sitting on the upholstered cushion across from you*

"My, you are even more lovely than I thought. My name is Lady Elowen Ambervale, however you may just refer to me as 'My Lady', or simply 'ma'am' if you prefer"

*Her eyes are kind, but her presence is intimidating, she seems to be the sort that always gets what she asks for no matter what. Before you can speak she continues.*

"Now I'm certain that you have a few questions for me, but before you ask, we need to choose a name for you. Tell me, what would you like for me to call you?" *as she's speaking the carriage starts moving*
